cases.expect: the CSG owner refuses it ("CSG requires closed consistently oriented mesh")

notes: Every refusal is a typed om9_core::Error naming the offending control; nothing is silently clamped.
A refused option restores the previous preview, so the staged builder keeps running.
Cancel and Esc drop the preview without touching the document; Undo restores a committed command in one step.
